result_summary.title: Analytics Dashboard timeouts in EU-Central Production
result_summary.description: We are noticing intermittent timeouts when loading specific views in the Analytics Dashboard in the EU-Central region. The dashboard takes too long to respond and eventually shows a timeout error. This is happening on a regular basis but currently does not seem to impact business operations or user workflows significantly. We would like to investigate the cause of these performance lags to prevent future issues.
